name: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay
description: IIT Bombay is recognized worldwide as a leader in the field of engineering education and research. Reputed for the outstanding calibre of students graduating from its undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, the institute attracts the best students from the country.

name: Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute
description: Established in 1887, VJTI is one of India's oldest and most prestigious engineering institutes. It is consistently ranked among the top colleges in Maharashtra for its rigorous academic standards and elite placements.

name: Institute of Chemical Technology
description: A premier deemed university and a global leader in chemical engineering, technology, and pharmacy. Formerly known as UDCT, it is renowned for its research output and industry-ready graduates.

name: Sardar Patel Institute of Technology
description: An autonomous private engineering college affiliated with Mumbai University. Highly sought after for its Computer Science and IT programs, known for excellent technical pedagogy.

name: Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering
description: A premier private engineering institution known for its state-of-the-art infrastructure and strong performance in university examinations. It maintains close ties with the tech industry in Mumbai.

name: COEP Technological University
description: One of the oldest engineering colleges in Asia, COEP recently gained university status. It continues to be a top choice for students due to its rich heritage and massive corporate network.

name: Pune Institute of Computer Technology
description: A specialized institute widely regarded as one of the best for Computer Engineering and Information Technology. It is famous for high placement rates in top global tech companies.

name: Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology
description: VNIT Nagpur is one of the thirty-one National Institutes of Technology in the country. It is a premier institute for technical education and research.

name: Walchand College of Engineering
description: One of the most prestigious govt-aided autonomous colleges in Maharashtra, known for its strong technical culture and alumni base.
